q: A topological dynamical system (X,T) is called minimal if X has no proper closed T-invariant subsets. Equivalently, every orbit is:
exp: Minimality: every orbit is dense. Minimal systems are the 'atoms' of topological dynamics—they cannot be decomposed further. Irrational rotations on the circle are minimal; every system contains a minimal subsystem (Auslander-Ellis theorem).
